children: the Sub-Contract Order Deed executed as a deed by the Contractor and Subcontractor for the provision of the Subcontract Works in connection with the Project.

children.name: text
children: Subcontract Sum Analysis

children.name: text
children: the breakdown of the Price appended to the Subcontract as a Contract Document.

children.name: text
children: Subcontract Works

children.name: text
children: the subcontract works described in the Subcontract Order as may be varied in accordance with this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: Subcontractor

children.name: text
children: the person, firm or company specified as the Subcontractor in the Subcontract Order.

children.name: text
children: Third Party Agreement

children.name: text
children: any agreement entered or to be entered into by the Contractor or the Employer with a funder or other third party in relation to the carrying out, management, financing, letting, sale, or use of the Project and/or the Site, or otherwise in connection with the Project and/or the Site.

children.name: text
children: Any term importing the singular includes the plural and vice versa and any reference to person includes individuals, partnerships, corporate bodies and any entity having legal capacity.

children.name: text
children: References to Statutory Requirements include those Statutory Requirements as from time to time amended, re-enacted or consolidated and any orders, regulations, rules and the like issued under or in connection with the same.

children.name: text
children: References to party or parties means the Contractor and/or the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract, including the obligations on the Subcontractor within it concerning and requiring compliance with the Main Contract, shall not be construed or interpreted against or to the disadvantage of the Contractor on the grounds that this Subcontract represents the Contractor's standard terms and conditions of business and/or that this Subcontract and/or any particular term or condition hereof may have originated from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Where under this Subcontract an act is required to be done within a specified period of days after or from a specified date, the period shall begin immediately after that date. Where the period would include Christmas Day, Good Friday or a day which under the Banking and Financial Dealings Act 1971 is a bank holiday that day shall be excluded.

children.name: text
children: Any words following the terms "including", "include", "in particular" or any similar expression shall be construed as illustrative and shall not limit the sense of the words, description, definition, phrase or terms preceding those terms.

children.name: text
children: No failure or delay by the Contractor to exercise any right or remedy provided under this Subcontract or in law (including the exercise of any condition precedent) (“{b:remedy}”) or the single or partial exercise of that remedy constitutes a waiver of that remedy or precludes or restricts further exercise of that remedy.

children.name: text
children: {b:Applicable Conditions }

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract constitutes the entire agreement between the parties relating to the subject matter of this Subcontract and supersedes and extinguishes any prior drafts, agreements, undertakings, representations, warranties and arrangements of any nature whatsoever, whether or not in writing, between the parties in relation to the subject matter of this Subcontract including but not limited to the Subcontractor’s own terms of business.

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract shall have effect as if executed when the Subcontractor first performed any work, services or activities forming part of or in relation to the Subcontract Works and the terms and conditions of this Subcontract shall apply and be deemed to have applied to any such works, services or activities prior to the date of this Subcontract including if carried out under any letter of intent or pre-construction services agreement in which case any and all amounts paid by the Contractor to the Subcontractor under such agreement shall be treated as having been paid on account of the Price.

children.name: text
children: Save to the extent expressly included in the Subcontract Documents, this Subcontract excludes any terms and conditions stipulated or referred to by the Subcontractor in any quotation, correspondence and/or any subsequent acknowledgement of the Subcontract Order. The carrying out of the Subcontract Works or any part of them by the Subcontractor is deemed to be its acceptance of this Subcontract. No conduct on the part of the Contractor (including but not limited to any instructions to carry out any of the Subcontract Works, whether on or off Site) other than an express written authorisation pursuant to Clause 2.8 shall constitute any acceptance of any variation to or departure from the terms of this Subcontract or the incorporation of any terms and conditions which are not expressly contained in this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The parties acknowledge and agree that they have not entered into this Subcontract in reliance on any statement or representation of any person (whether a party to this Subcontract or not) other than as expressly incorporated in this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The documents forming this Subcontract are to be taken as mutually explanatory of one another. If there is any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy between the Subcontract Order, these Subcontract Terms and Conditions, and any of the Subcontract Documents, the priority shall be in accordance with the following sequence:

children.name: text
children: the Subcontract Order;

children.name: text
children: these Subcontract Terms and Conditions;

children.name: text
children: the Subcontract Sum Analysis;

children.name: text
children: Pre-Commencement Meeting Minutes; and

children.name: text
children: all other Subcontract Documents as detailed in the Subcontract Order.

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontractor finds an ambiguity or discrepancy in the Subcontract Documents, it shall promptly give notice to the Contractor describing the same.

children.name: text
children: After receiving such notice, or if the Contractor itself finds an ambiguity or discrepancy in the Subcontract Documents, the Contractor shall issue the necessary clarification or instruction to the Subcontractor which the Subcontractor shall comply with without any entitlement to adjustment of the Price or the Period for Completion.

children.name: text
children: No amendment to this Subcontract is valid and binding unless authorised in writing by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract is governed by and is to be construed in accordance with English law.

children.name: text
children: The parties irrevocably agree that the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute which may arise out of or in connection with this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Main Contract & Third Party Agreements}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor acknowledges, warrants and undertakes that it is, and shall be deemed to be, fully aware of the terms of the Main Contract and any Third Party Agreement whether or not actually inspected. The Contractor shall, if so requested by the Subcontractor, provide the Subcontractor with copies of the Main Contract and any Third Party Agreement (save that the Contractor may, at its discretion, redact any financial details and/or commercially sensitive information).

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out and complete the Subcontract Works in such manner and at such times so that no act, omission or default of the Subcontractor in relation thereto shall cause or contribute to any breach by the Contractor of any of its obligations under the Main Contract or any breach by the Contractor and/or the Employer of their obligations under or in relation to any Third Party Agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall comply with any and all procedures laid down in the Main Contract and any Third Party Agreement for the approval of changes in design, specification or materials and/or the testing, commissioning and/or inspection of the works or any part or parts of the works comprising the Subcontract Works for which the Subcontractor is responsible under this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall indemnify and keep the Contractor indemnified against all claims as a result of the Subcontractor's acts and/or omissions, negligence, breaches and/or defaults which cause or contribute to the Contractor or the Employer suffering or being in breach of any Third Party Agreement.

children.name: text
children: To the extent that the Contractor accepts responsibility for the adequacy, suitability and/or accuracy of the contents of the Employer’s Requirements under the Main Contract, the Subcontractor shall have the same degree of responsibility under this Subcontract to the extent that the Employer’s Requirements relate to the part or parts of the Subcontract Works that the Subcontractor is responsible for designing.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor has checked the Employer’s Requirements and:

children.name: text
children: is satisfied that the Employer’s Requirements are feasible, practical and sufficient to enable the Subcontractor to carry out its obligations for the design and/or construction of the Subcontract Works to the extent set out therein and the Subcontractor has agreed to accept responsibility for such feasibility, practicality and sufficiency insofar as they relate to the Subcontractor’s responsibility for the design and/or construction of the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: confirms that there is no mistake, inaccuracy, inconsistency, discrepancy or divergence in or between this Subcontract and the Employer’s Requirements; and

children.name: text
children: confirms that the Subcontract Works shall meet the Employer’s Requirements in all respects.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to the foregoing, the Subcontractor shall achieve and, as and when required to do so by the Contractor, demonstrate such achievement (by the provision of reports and other information as reasonably required by the Contractor) with any key performance and/or social value indicators which are set out in the Minutes. The Subcontractor shall indemnify and keep the Contractor indemnified against any and all losses which the Contractor may suffer as a result of the Subcontractor's acts and/or omissions, negligence, breaches and/or defaults which cause or contribute to the Contractor failing to meet in any way the key performance and/or social value indicators which the Contractor is obliged to achieve pursuant to the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Subcontractor’s Obligations}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out and complete the Subcontract Works:

children.name: text
children: in a proper and workmanlike manner and in compliance with this Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: regularly and diligently and in accordance with the Programme and the progress of the Project;

children.name: text
children: to the standard to be expected of a professional and competent contractor of the Subcontractor’s specialist discipline who is experienced in working on projects of a similar, size, scope, nature, complexity and value to the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: in accordance with the instructions issued from time to time by the Contractor and all other requirements of the Contractor;

children.name: text
children: in accordance with the Statutory Requirements and the requirements of any local authority or statutory undertaker;

children.name: text
children: in compliance with the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 (“{b:CDM}”) and the Construction Phase Plan (pursuant to CDM Regulation 12);

children.name: text
children: in compliance with all of the Contractor’s policies relating to the Subcontract and to the Project, including but not limited to the Contractor’s health and safety policy, quality and assurance policy, environmental policy, and social value policy; and

children.name: text
children: in compliance with all applicable health and safety legislation, including but not limited to the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974 and any requirements of the Health and Safety Executive.

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise stated in the Subcontract Documents, the Subcontractor shall be responsible at its own cost for all permissions, consents, approvals, notices, and applications necessary for the Subcontract Works. The Subcontractor shall have no responsibility for procuring any required planning permissions, listed building consents or building control approvals but for the avoidance of doubt the foregoing is without prejudice to any obligation on the Subcontractor to comply with the same (including but not limited to doing all that would be reasonable and necessary to facilitate the Contractor’s and/or Employer’s procurement of the same).

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall ensure that its employees, agents and all other persons employed or engaged on or in connection with the Subcontract Works are registered cardholders under the Construction Skills Certification Scheme (CSCS) or qualified under an equivalent recognised qualification scheme.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor must comply with any request made by the Contractor to remove any person employed or engaged by the Subcontractor on the Project without liability or cost to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is to provide on Site during working hours a competent person authorised to receive instructions on behalf of the Subcontractor and to ensure the proper administration, co-ordination and supervision of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: {em:Building Safety}

children.name: text
children: On or before the date of this Subcontract, the Subcontractor shall have completed the Contractor’s competency questionnaire. The provision of a competency questionnaire completed by the Subcontractor, to the Contractor’s satisfaction, shall be condition precedent to the Contractor’s liability to make any payments to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor warrants that it is competent to fulfil the duties of a ‘contractor’ and (where applicable) a ‘designer’ for the purposes of the Dutyholder Regulations in relation to the Subcontract Works and has allocated and will allocate adequate resources to enable it to comply with those duties (including but not limited to carrying out the Subcontract Works in accordance with all relevant requirements of the Building Regulations 2010 (as amended)). The Subcontractor shall indemnify the Contractor against any costs, losses, expenses, liabilities, claims or proceedings whatsoever in connection with the Subcontractor’s failure to comply with those duties.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall indemnify the Contractor against any costs, losses, expenses, liabilities and claims in connection with any delay in receipt of any necessary permission or approval of any statutory body, including but not limited to any delay in the issuing of the completion certificate pursuant to the Building Regulations 2010 (as amended) by the relevant authority, to the extent caused or contributed to by the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor warrants that the any persons engaged or employed by the Subcontractor in connection with the Subcontract Works (“{b:Subcontractor’s Persons}”) are competent and shall remain competent to perform all duties and functions required to be performed by them under the Dutyholder Regulations.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor warrants that it shall immediately notify the Contractor upon becoming aware of any reason why the Subcontractor or any Subcontractor’s Persons may no longer be so competent.

children.name: text
children: As and when requested to do so by the Contractor, the Subcontractor shall give to the Contractor a written record of the steps taken under regulation 11E(2) of the Dutyholder Regulations when appointing each of the Subcontractor's Persons.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall have no entitlement to any extension of time to the Period for Completion and/or any loss or expense or other adjustment to the Price to the extent the Subcontractor has caused or contributed to a delay in receipt of any necessary permission or approval of any statutory body, including but not limited to any delay in the issuing of the completion certificate pursuant to the Building Regulations 2010 (as amended) by the relevant authority.

children.name: text
children: As a condition precedent to practical completion of the Subcontract Works, the Subcontractor shall provide a written statement to the Contractor that:

children.name: text
children: the Subcontract Works are complete;

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor has fulfilled all their duties as a ‘contractor’ and (where applicable) ‘designer’ under the Dutyholder Regulations; and

children.name: text
children: the Subcontract Work complies with all applicable requirements of the Building Regulations 2010 (as amended).

children.name: text
children: {em:Higher-Risk Buildings}

children.name: text
children: Where and to the extent the Project involves works to a Higher-Risk Building, the Subcontractor acknowledges that the Contractor is under certain obligations regarding the provision of digital records and other information in respect of the Subcontract Works. The Subcontractor shall promptly provide any such digital records and information as the Contractor may require in order to fulfil those obligations, including but not limited to:

children.name: text
children: Golden Thread Information; and

children.name: text
children: any information to comply with, and support, the mandatory occurrence reporting system.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall promptly report any safety occurrences in accordance with the mandatory occurrence reporting system.

children.name: text
children: Where the Subcontractor’s negligence, breach of statutory duty, omission, default of breach of this Subcontract causes or contributes to a “notifiable change” or “major change” (each as defined in The Building (Higher-Risk Buildings Procedures) (England) Regulations 2023):

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor shall have no entitlement to any adjustment of the  Price  or  any  extension  of  the  Period  for  Completion  in  connection therewith; and

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor shall indemnify and keep the Contractor indemnified against any and all claims, losses, costs and expenses incurred (or likely to be incurred) by the Contractor as a result of any and all delays and/or disruption caused to practical completion of the Project as a result thereof

children.name: text
children: {em:Competency and compliance}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor acknowledges that it is from time to time required by the Contractor to complete the following questionnaires:

children.name: text
children: Sub-Contractors Profile Questionnaire;

children.name: text
children: Sub-Contractors Safety, Health, Environment & Quality Questionnaire,

children.name: text
children: and the Subcontractor shall promptly notify the Contractor if at any time there is a change to the information provided in any such questionnaires, or the Subcontractor is or becomes aware of any error, inaccuracy or inadequacy in the information provided.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall ensure that each employee, labourer or worker who is engaged by or on behalf of the Subcontractor and working on the Site (“{b:On Site Operative}”) is competent (including but not limited to having the relevant skills and experience necessary) and the Subcontractor shall not permit any On Site Operative to have access to the Site where they are not competent. Without limiting the foregoing, the Subcontractor shall ensure that each such On Site Operative holds a valid and relevant CSCS card.

children.name: text
children: From time to time as and when reasonably requested by the Contractor, the Subcontractor shall provide evidence of their compliance with Clause 4.18 and in the event that the Subcontractor is unable to evidence that any On Site Operative is not competent the Contractor shall have the right to require the immediate removal from the Site of such operative until the relevant time that their competence can be evidenced to the Contractor’s reasonable satisfaction.

children.name: text
children: {em:Social values}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall comply with any requirements as are allocated to the Subcontractor under paragraph 3.0 of the Minutes, and supply all such information and reports to the Contractor as may be reasonably required to demonstrate such compliance from time to time.

children.name: text
children: {b:Materials and Goods}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor warrants and undertakes to the Contractor that it has not specified and will not use and (as appropriate) it has not and will not authorise or approve the specification or use by others within the Subcontract Works of materials or goods which are:

children.name: text
children: generally known at the time of use to be deleterious to health and safety or to the durability of buildings and/or other structures and/or finishes and/or plant and machinery in the particular circumstances in which they are used;

children.name: text
children: not in conformity with good building practice, relevant British standards or codes of practice;

children.name: text
children: not new (except where expressly permitted under this Subcontract) and of satisfactory quality; or

children.name: text
children: in contravention of the recommendations of the publications "Good Practice in the Selection of Construction Materials" (2011, published by the British Council for Offices) or the Building Research Establishment Digest current at the date of specification.

children.name: text
children: Should the Subcontractor become aware that any materials or goods have been used in the Project in breach of this Clause 5, it shall inform the Contractor immediately in writing.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor, exercising the standard of skill, care and diligence referred to in Clause 4.1.3, keep the Contractor advised of any research or other information of which the Subcontractor is or ought reasonably to be aware and which ought properly to cause the Contractor to give consideration to the safety of the design or manner of construction of the Project or of any materials incorporated therein.

children.name: text
children: {b:Design}

children.name: text
children: To the extent the Subcontractor is responsible for the design of all or any part of the Subcontract Works (as detailed in the Subcontract Order):

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor shall provide copies of all drawings, details, specifications and other documents for comment by the Contractor in good time, and in sufficient time to ensure compliance by the Contractor with their own obligations under the Main Contract and as required by paragraph 8.0 of the Minutes, and in sufficient time to avoid delay to the Subcontract Works and the Project; and

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor at its own cost shall take into account any comments of the Contractor and incorporate them into the drawings, specifications, or other documents and re-submit them to the Contractor within a reasonable time period, in each case in full compliance with and in sufficient time to enable the Contractor to comply with the Contractor’s design development obligations in the Main Contract relevant to the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not vary the design of the Subcontract Works without prior written instruction from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor warrants to the Contractor that in respect of any design for which it is responsible, it has and will continue to exercise the same level of skill, care and diligence as the Contractor is required to exercise in respect of design under the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Effect of Approvals }

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Subcontract no direction, admission, approach, consent, approval, confirmation, comment, sanction, acknowledgement or advice made or given by or on behalf of the Contractor shall in any way relieve the Subcontractor from its liabilities or obligations under this Subcontract, nor shall such liabilities or obligations be restricted or qualified in any way.

children.name: text
children: {b:Copyright}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor grants to the Contractor an irrevocable, royalty free, non-exclusive licence to copy and use the Documents and to reproduce the designs and the content of them for any purpose relating to the Project, including the construction, completion, maintenance, letting, sale, promotion, advertisement, reinstatement, refurbishment and repair of the Subcontract Works and the Project. The Subcontractor shall supply the Contractor (without charge) with a copy of the Documents immediately on the Contractor’s request (whether before or after termination of the Subcontract or the Subcontractor’s employment under the Subcontract (including termination for breach by the Contractor)).

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be liable for and shall indemnify the Contractor against any and all expenses, liabilities, losses, claims or proceedings the Contractor may incur in the event:

children.name: text
children: that the rights granted by the Subcontractor pursuant to this Clause 8 are found to be invalid, ineffective or impaired in any way; and/or

children.name: text
children: of any claim by any third party (whether upheld or not) that the exercise of the rights granted by the Subcontractor pursuant to this Clause 8 infringe the rights of such third party.

children.name: text
children: {b:Variations}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may at any time issue written instructions to the Subcontractor in relation to the Subcontract Works including instructions requiring a variation to the Subcontract Works. A variation may include any addition, alteration to and/or omission from the Subcontract Works. The Contractor shall be entitled without financial or other limit to omit any part or all of the Subcontract Works and may perform that work either by itself or by engaging others. The Subcontractor shall have no claim or entitlement to be paid the relevant portion of the Price for the omitted works, or any indirect or consequential loss including but not limited to loss of profit, loss of contract, or any other loss arising from that omission.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall forthwith comply with all instructions issued under Clause 9.1. If within 5 days after receipt of a written notice from the Contractor requiring compliance with an instruction, the Subcontractor does not comply, then the Contractor may give effect to that instruction itself or engage others to do so and the Subcontractor shall be liable for all additional costs incurred by the Contractor as a result, which the Contractor may set-off against the Price.

children.name: text
children: To the extent that an instruction issued under Clause 9.1 is:

children.name: text
children: an alteration or modification of the design, quality or quantity of the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: the imposition of or alteration in relation to any obligations or restrictions contained in the Subcontract Documents in regard to the following matters:

children.name: text
children: access to the Site or use of any specific parts of the Site;

children.name: text
children: limitations of working space;

children.name: text
children: limitations of working hours;

children.name: text
children: the carrying out of the Subcontract Works in any specific order,

children.name: text
children: (a “{b:Variation}”) then the Subcontractor and the Contractor shall endeavour agree the adjustment to the Price in respect of such Variation before the Variation is carried out.

children.name: text
children: If the amount is not agreed pursuant to Clause 9.3 it shall be valued by the Contractor in accordance with the rates and prices upon which the Price has been calculated or where, in the opinion of the Contractor such rates and prices cannot reasonably be used, at fair rates and values. The Contractor will notify the Subcontractor of the rates and values that it will use (which notification may be by way of the valuation) and if the Subcontractor does not reasonably object in writing to those rates and values within 7 days of receipt of the notification the Subcontractor shall be deemed to have agreed those rates and values.

children.name: text
children: Not less than monthly during the carrying out of the Subcontract Works the Subcontractor shall submit to the Contractor, in such form and containing such detail and supporting information as the Contractor may require, details of the Subcontractor’s forecasted final account which shall take account of all instructed and anticipated variations.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice and separately to its obligations under Clause 9.5 if the Subcontractor considers itself entitled to an adjustment of the Price under this Subcontract, as a condition precedent to any such entitlement it must give notice to the Contractor of the event or circumstance giving rise to the claim with reasonably detailed substantiation of the amount to which it considers it is entitled and the basis on which that has been calculated. The notice must be given as soon as practicable and not later than 7 days after the Subcontractor became aware, or should have become aware, of the event or circumstance. The substantiation must be given as soon as practicable and not later than 7 days after the notice. If the Subcontractor does not give both the notice and the substantiation within those time periods, the Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any adjustment of the Price and the Contractor shall be discharged from all liability in connection with the claim. Compliance with Clause 9.5 does not discharge or satisfy the obligations under this Clause 9.6.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor agrees that it shall not be entitled to recover, and hereby waives, any amount by way of compensation, extension of time or addition to the Price or be entitled to any relief from its obligations under this Subcontract which is greater than the amount recovered by or the relief granted to the Contractor in relation to any equivalent provision in the Main Contract provided that the Contractor shall use reasonable endeavours to pursue its full entitlement.

children.name: text
children: {b: Subcontract attendances/facilities}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is to supply all labour, materials, tools and plant necessary for carrying out the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Unless expressly stated otherwise in this Subcontract:

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor shall at its own cost make all provision for transporting, loading, sorting, storing, protecting and insuring:

children.name: text
children: its materials until fully incorporated into the Subcontract Works; and

children.name: text
children: its plant and tools, and the Contractor shall not be liable for any loss or damage to the same howsoever arising;

children.name: text
children: power and water shall be provided by the Contractor for distribution by the Subcontractor and the Subcontractor at its own cost shall provide and supply all necessary lighting and security for the purposes of the Subcontract Works; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor will provide the facilities set out in the Attendance Schedule to the Subcontractor free of charge.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall keep the Site clean and tidy at all times and shall at its own cost remove its own spoil, waste, rubbish and temporary works (e.g. shuttering) from Site.

children.name: text
children: {b:Commencement and Completion of the Subcontract Works}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall commence and carry out its obligations under this Subcontract in full compliance with the Programme and following receipt of a written notice to commence Subcontract Works on Site, issued by the Contractor pursuant to paragraph 7.0 of the Minutes, shall commence the Subcontract Works on Site on the date specified in such notice.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall achieve practical completion of the Subcontract Works within the Period for Completion, and shall use its best endeavours to prevent and mitigate any delay to the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontractor fails to achieve:

children.name: text
children: any Subcontract Milestone by the relevant milestone date specified in the Programme; or

children.name: text
children: practical completion of the Subcontract Works within the Period for Completion,

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall be entitled to and may notify the Subcontractor that it requires payment of or shall deduct from any amounts otherwise due to the Subcontractor under this Subcontract liquidated damages for the delay at the relevant rate specified in the Subcontract Order and/or the Minutes.

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontract Works are delayed or are likely to be delayed, the Subcontractor shall forthwith notify the Contractor in writing identifying the cause with an estimate of the impact on the Period for Completion and setting out the steps it has taken and will take to mitigate the delay in compliance with Clause 11.2 ("{b:Delay Notice}").

children.name: text
children: The Delay Notice must as a condition precedent to any entitlement to an extension of time for the relevant cause be issued not later than 7 days after the Subcontractor became aware, or should have become aware, of the delay or likely delay. The Contractor shall have no obligation to consider any Delay Notice issued after this period, and the Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any extension of time under this Clause 11 in respect of that delay or likely delay.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor may also identify in the Delay Notice any of the following events if in its reasonable opinion any are a relevant cause of the delay:

children.name: text
children: an instruction for a variation to the Subcontract Works under Clause 9.1;

children.name: text
children: failure by the Contractor to allow access to the Site when required during the Period for Completion;

children.name: text
children: any impediment, prevention or default, whether by act or omission by the Contractor or those engaged on the Project by the Contractor or any party for whom the Contractor is responsible; and

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor's proper exercise of its right to suspend all or any of its obligations under the Subcontract,

children.name: text
children: then subject to Clauses 11.4 – 11.5, if the Contractor agrees that such event has caused the delay, and provided always that the Subcontractor shall not become entitled to any extension of time on account of any circumstance arising by reason of its own error, omission, negligence or default, the  Contractor shall confirm in writing to the Subcontractor (with reasons) the period of the extension to the Period for Completion and confirm the new Period for Completion.

children.name: text
children: Without affecting any other right or remedy which the Contractor may possess, if the Subcontractor is, in the Contractor’s opinion (such opinion to be final and conclusive) in breach of its obligations under Clause 4.1.2, then the Contractor may: (1) introduce additional labour onto the Subcontract Works (or any part of them) and any costs, expenses or losses which the Contractor incurs as a result may be deducted from any monies due or to become due to the Subcontractor or may be recoverable from the Subcontractor as a debt; and/or (2) omit any part of the Subcontract Works and may perform that work itself or by engaging others and the Subcontractor shall be liable for all additional costs incurred by the Contractor and shall have no claim for loss of profit, loss of contract or any loss arising from that omission.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall give the Contractor not less than 5 days’ notice of the date when the Subcontractor considers the Subcontract Works will be practically complete. The Subcontractor may enclose with this notice a draft snagging list to be agreed with the Contractor and remedied by the Subcontractor after practical completion of the Subcontract Works. Upon receipt of the Subcontractor’s notice the Contractor will attend site as soon as reasonably practicable to inspect the Subcontract Works.  If the Contractor does not consider the Subcontract Works are practically complete then the process set out in this Clause 11.8 shall be repeated and costs, expenses and losses (including wasted management time) which the Contractor incurs in respect of all subsequent inspections of the Subcontract Works shall be recoverable from the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontract Works shall not be considered practically complete until the Subcontractor has provided: (1) all manufacturer guarantees and warranties required under the Subcontract; (2) all collateral warranties required under Clause 26; (3) all operation and maintenance manuals required under the Subcontract; and (4) a written undertaking to the Contractor to complete all snagging items within a time period specified by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Once the Subcontract Works are practically complete in accordance with Clause 11.8, the Contractor shall confirm that in writing to the Subcontractor with a list of any snagging items

children.name: text
children: {b:Site Conditions}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is deemed to have inspected the Site, access and egress to and from the Site, and the physical conditions (including the sub-surface conditions and prior works) and other conditions of or affecting the Site and the materials, equipment, and facilities required to carry out the Subcontract Works. The Subcontractor is deemed to have fully acquainted itself with the same and to have obtained all necessary information as to risks, contingencies and all other circumstances which may influence or affect the execution of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Before starting work on Site, the Subcontractor shall satisfy itself as to the suitability of all prior work to which the Subcontract Works are to be fixed or which may influence or affect the carrying out of or the quality of the Subcontract Works. The Subcontractor shall immediately notify the Contractor of any prior work which the Subcontractor considers will affect the carrying out of or quality of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is responsible for the accurate setting out of the Subcontract Works and is to ensure that the execution of the Subcontract Works is coordinated with the work of the other subcontractors under the direction of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Any information prepared by or on behalf of the Contractor (including any survey, report or document) relating in whole or in part to the physical conditions (including the sub-surface conditions and prior works) and other conditions of or affecting the Site is provided for information only. The Contractor makes no representation or warranty as to the accuracy or completeness of any such information or for any representation or statement contained therein, whether made negligently or otherwise and the Subcontractor shall make no claim against the Contractor for misrepresentation or misstatement, whether made negligently or otherwise, in respect of such information.

children.name: text
children: No failure on the part of the Subcontractor to discover or foresee any physical conditions and/or other conditions affecting the site and/or any risks, prior work, contingencies or circumstances whatsoever referred to in this Clause 12 (whether the same ought reasonably to have been discovered or foreseen or not), shall entitle the Subcontractor to an adjustment of the Price or an extension of the Period for Completion.

children.name: text
children: {b:Method Statement}

children.name: text
children: Not less than 14 days before the commencement of the Subcontract Works on Site, the Subcontractor shall provide to the Contractor a Method Statement.

children.name: text
children: {b: Coordination}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall at all times collaboratively coordinate, consult with and co-operate with all other consultants and sub-contractors or suppliers engaged by the Contractor and/or the Employer in connection with the Project to the extent required in order to diligently carry out the Subcontract Works or as otherwise reasonably required by the Contractor from time to time.

children.name: text
children: {b: Defects}

children.name: text
children: During the Rectification Period, the Subcontractor shall make good at its own cost and in accordance with any instruction of the Contractor all defects, shrinkages and other faults in the Subcontract Works or any part of them due to any failure of the Subcontractor to comply with its obligations in respect of this Subcontract. Where the Contractor considers that such making good has been achieved, it shall notify the Subcontractor to that effect and the date of that notification shall be no later than the issue of the relevant certificate of making good / defects certificate or equivalent under the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: If any loss or damage to the Project (including any works carried out by specialist subcontractors) or completed Subcontract Works or any part thereof is caused by the existence of any defect or by the Subcontractor complying with any instruction issued under Clause 9.1 or Clause 15.1, the Contractor may issue instructions requiring such loss or damage to be made good. If the Contractor shall so instruct, the Subcontractor shall, within a reasonable time after receipt of the same, comply with such instruction at its own cost. The Subcontractor shall also pay the cost of breaking out and or removal and reinstatement or replacement by the Contractor (or if applicable the appropriate specialist subcontractor) of existing works as a result of any such defect or as necessary in order to comply with an instruction under Clause 9.1 or Clause 15.1.

children.name: text
children: Failure by the Subcontractor to comply with the provisions of this Clause 15 shall entitle the Contractor to execute (and/or procure the execution by others of) those outstanding works and recover all associated costs from the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: {b: Payment}

children.name: text
children: Payment under this Subcontract shall be valued in monthly instalments in accordance with the schedule of payment dates in the Subcontract Documents. The "{b:Valuation Date}" shall in each case be the monthly payment application date specified in such schedule and if no schedule of payment dates is included or once all payment application dates specified in such schedule have elapsed, the "{b:Valuation Date}" for each instalment shall be the final working day of each month. The Subcontractor shall submit each application for payment no later than each Valuation Date, on each occasion quoting the Subcontract Order number and stating the sum that the Subcontractor considers to be due to the Subcontractor and the basis upon which that sum is calculated ("{b:Subcontractor Payment Application}"). The due date ("{b:Due Date}") for each payment shall be 7 days after each Valuation Date and in the event the Subcontractor has failed to submit a Subcontractor Payment Application by the Valuation Date the Subcontractor shall be deemed to have issued a Subcontractor Payment Application for £0. The final date for each payment shall be 42 days after the relevant Due Date ("{b:Final Date for Payment}").

children.name: text
children: The amount due to the Subcontractor shall be:

children.name: text
children: the total value of the work properly executed calculated in accordance with the rates and prices in the Subcontract; {b:and}

children.name: text
children: the amounts of any additions to the Price ascertained under the Subcontract, {b:less}

children.name: text
children: the amounts of any omissions to the Price ascertained under the Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: all amounts previously due;

children.name: text
children: (where applicable) retention under Clause 17;

children.name: text
children: any amounts due from the Subcontractor to the Contractor; and

children.name: text
children: any other amounts that the Contractor is entitled to withhold, deduct or set-off pursuant to the terms of the Subcontract or otherwise arising out of or in connection with the Subcontract including liquidated damages under Clause 11.3,

provided that the Contractor shall be entitled to withhold the entirety of any amounts otherwise due to the Subcontractor under this Subcontract until the Subcontractor has provided to the Contractor a fully and properly executed copy of this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: Not later than 5 days after the Due Date the Contractor shall give a notice to the Subcontractor specifying the sum that it considers to be or to have been due at the Due Date (even if that sum is zero or a negative amount) and the basis upon which that sum has been calculated ("{b:Contractor’s Payment Notice}") and, subject to Clause 16.5, the sum to be paid by the Contractor shall be the sum specified in the Contractor’s Payment Notice.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor fails to issue a Contractor’s Payment Notice in accordance with Clause 16.3 the sum to be paid by the Contractor shall, subject to Clause 16.5, be the sum specified in the Subcontractor Payment Application.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor intends to pay less than the sum specified in the Contractor’s Payment Notice or, if applicable under Clause 16.4 in the Subcontractor Payment Application, then it shall not later than one day before the Final Date for Payment give a notice to the Subcontractor specifying the sum that the Contractor considers to be due and the basis upon which that sum is calculated (“{b:Pay Less Notice}”).

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Subcontract, the Contractor need not pay any sum due in respect of any payment if the Subcontractor becomes Insolvent after the latest that a Pay Less Notice may be given under Clause 16.5 in respect of that payment.

children.name: text
children: In the event that the sum stated as due in a Contractor’s Payment Notice or a Pay Less Notice is a negative figure showing a balance due to the Contractor to be paid to the Subcontractor, the Subcontractor pay the sum stated in the Contractor’s Payment Notice or Pay Less Notice (as applicable) to the Contractor by the Final Date for Payment.

children.name: text
children: In the event that the Employer becomes Insolvent, the Contractor shall be obliged to pay to the Subcontractor any sums due pursuant to this Subcontract only if and when the Contractor receives such sums from the Employer.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to any other right or remedy of the Subcontractor, if the Contractor fails to make any payment properly due under this Subcontract by the Final Date for Payment other than pursuant to and to the extent specified in a valid Pay Less Notice and this failure continues for 7 days then the Subcontractor may charge the Contractor, and the Contractor shall pay to the Subcontractor, interest on the unpaid amount at the rate of two percent (2%) per annum above the base rate of the Bank of England from the Final Date for Payment until the outstanding payment is made in full by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {em:VAT}

children.name: text
children: The Price is exclusive of VAT and, in relation to each payment to the Subcontractor for any supply made under this Subcontract:

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor shall within two Business Days following the issue by the Contractor of a Contractor’s Payment Notice issue to the Contractor an appropriate VAT invoice in respect of such supply, indicating whether or not the reverse charge applies to the supply; and

children.name: text
children: subject to the Subcontractor complying with Clause 16.10.1 and unless the reverse charge applies, the Contractor shall in addition pay to the Subcontractor the amount of any VAT properly chargeable in respect of such supply.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall include within each Subcontractor Payment Application a request for the Contractor to confirm in writing whether the reverse charge applies to the supply to which the Subcontractor Payment Application relates. The Contractor shall provide such confirmation with, or not later than the issue of, the Contractor’s Payment Notice relating to such supply.

children.name: text
children: If the paying party for the final payment under Clause 19.4 is the Contractor, the Subcontractor shall not later than the Due Date for payment of the Final Account (in accordance with Clause 19.4) request the Contractor to confirm in writing whether the reverse charge applies to the supply to which the final payment relates and the Contractor shall provide such confirmation.

children.name: text
children: References to the "reverse charge applying" (or similar) mean any case where the recipient of a supply for VAT purposes, or a member of a VAT group of which the recipient of the supply is a member, is required to account to the relevant tax authority for the VAT chargeable in respect of the supply.

children.name: text
children: {b: Retention}

children.name: text
children: The retention percentage specified in the Subcontract Order, if any, may be deducted by the Contractor from all sums that become due prior to practical completion of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Subject to receipt by the Contractor from the Subcontractor of a Subcontractor Payment Application in respect of the retention, one half of the retention shall become due to the Subcontractor six months after the later of practical completion of the Subcontract Works and (if applicable) the completion of any snagging items in the Subcontract Works. The balance of the retention shall be included within and payable to the Subcontractor with the final payment made under and pursuant to Clause 19.4 provided that the Subcontractor has made good all defects notified to it during the Rectification Period. Unless and until any such defects are made good, the Contractor shall be entitled to retain an appropriate amount of the retention from the Subcontractor in respect of the same.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to Clauses 19.3 and 19.4, if no Subcontract Payment Application for the retention is made by the Subcontractor within 18 months of the expiry of the Rectification Period, the Subcontractor’s entitlement to the retention is waived in full and the Contractor is under no obligation to return to the Subcontractor any or all of the retention.

children.name: text
children: {b: Suspension}

children.name: text
children: Without affecting the Subcontractor’s other rights and remedies, if the Contractor fails to pay the Subcontractor any sum payable by the Final Date for Payment and the failure continues for 7 days after the Subcontractor has given notice to the Contractor of its intention to suspend the performance of its obligations under the Subcontract and the ground or grounds on which it is intended to suspend performance, the Subcontractor may suspend performance of any or all of its obligations until payment is made in full.

children.name: text
children: Where the Subcontractor exercises its right of suspension under this Clause 18, it shall be entitled to a reasonable amount in respect of costs and expenses properly incurred by it as a direct result of the suspension.

children.name: text
children: Any Subcontractor Payment Applications in respect of any such reasonable costs and expenses shall be made to the Contractor in accordance with Clause 16, attaching evidence of the same.

children.name: text
children: In the event of any suspension by the Subcontractor under this Clause 18, within 7 days of remedy of the outstanding payment to which Clause 18.1 relates and payment by the Contractor to the Subcontractor of the costs and expenses to which the Subcontractor is entitled under and pursuant to Clause 18.2, the Subcontractor shall remobilise and recommence performance of its obligations under the Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b: Final Account}

children.name: text
children: No later than 28 days after the date of practical completion of the Subcontract Works, the Subcontractor shall submit to the Contractor its final account in full and sufficient detail for the Contractor to assess and agree with the Subcontractor the total final amount due and payable to the Subcontractor under this Subcontract. The Subcontractor shall only be entitled to make one such submission to the Contractor unless the Contractor at its absolute discretion agrees otherwise in writing.

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontractor does not issue its final account in accordance with and in the timescale specified in Clause 19.1, the Contractor shall be entitled to assess and issue its own final account calculation by which the Subcontractor shall be bound.

children.name: text
children: The final account issued by either the Subcontractor or the Contractor under this Clause 19 shall account for and be conclusive as to all extensions of the Period for Completion and adjustments to the Price under and pursuant to this Subcontract and the total of sums already paid by the Contractor to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: Unless disputed by the Contractor prior to the expiry of the Rectification Period, the final account shall be conclusive as to the final payment to be made by the Contractor to the Subcontractor. Clause 16 shall apply to payment of the final account to the Subcontractor on the basis that the final account shall be treated as a Subcontractor’s Payment Application for which the Due Date shall be the later of:

children.name: text
children: 28 days after the expiry of the Rectification Period; or

children.name: text
children: (where any defects, shrinkages or other faults have been instructed to be made good pursuant to Clause 15.1) 28 days after the satisfactory making good of all such defects, shrinkages or other faults which the Subcontractor is instructed to make good pursuant to clause 15.1.

children.name: text
children: {b: Set-Off}

children.name: text
children: Where under the Subcontract any sum of money is recoverable from or payable by the Subcontractor to the Contractor, at the Contractor’s discretion such sum may be deducted from or reduced by the amount of any sum or sums then due or which at any time may become due to the Subcontractor under the Subcontract or any other contract with the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b: Title and Risk}

children.name: text
children: Title to the materials and goods to be used in the Subcontract Works shall pass to the Contractor when they are delivered to Site or when they are paid for by the Contractor, whichever is earlier.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may, at its sole discretion, agree to the payment of materials and goods prior to their delivery to the Site. As a pre-condition to payment for any materials and goods prior to their delivery to Site, the Subcontractor must (as a minimum):

children.name: text
children: pass title in them to the Contractor by a vesting certificate in such form as the Contractor acting reasonably shall agree; and

children.name: text
children: set them aside in a separate place of storage where they are clearly marked as for the Project and the property of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding that title to the materials, goods, or any part of them vests in the Contractor, they shall remain at the risk of the Subcontractor until incorporation into the Project.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be responsible for the protection of the Subcontract Works against any loss and/or damage and is to take all necessary precautions in carrying out the Subcontract Works to prevent damage to other existing works and/or structures on or adjacent to the Project.

children.name: text
children: Risk in the plant, tools and equipment of the Subcontractor remains with the Subcontractor and the Contractor shall have no liability for loss or damage to the same howsoever caused.

children.name: text
children: {b:Construction Industry Scheme (“CIS”)}

children.name: text
children: This Clause 22 applies only if the CIS scheme is applicable to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor confirms it is and shall remain registered as a “subcontractor” under the CIS and the Subcontractor shall provide to the Contractor satisfactory evidence of this before commencing any work on Site.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is not entitled to payment under this Subcontract unless and until the satisfactory evidence of its registration under the CIS scheme, if applicable, is provided to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor is not satisfied with the evidence provided to it by the Subcontractor the Contractor shall notify the Subcontractor in writing.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to any other right of the Contractor to withhold payment, the Contractor at its sole discretion may make payment net of any statutory deduction in force at the time.

children.name: text
children: {b: Termination}

children.name: text
children: Without affecting any other rights which the Contractor may have, the Contractor shall be entitled by written notice to the Subcontractor to terminate the Subcontractor’s employment under the Subcontract forthwith if the Subcontractor:

children.name: text
children: is in breach of any obligation under the Subcontract which it fails to remedy within 5 days of a written notice from the Contractor specifying the breach and requiring that it be remedied within that period;

children.name: text
children: is Insolvent;

children.name: text
children: is unable to pay its debts or has taken any steps towards a formal insolvency process;

children.name: text
children: notifies the Contractor that the Subcontractor has ceased trading; or

children.name: text
children: for any other reason.

children.name: text
children: Upon termination of its employment, the Subcontractor shall:

children.name: text
children: take immediate steps to bring the Subcontract Works to a halt with all reasonable speed and economy (including advising and assisting the Contractor in relation to the protection and preservation of the Project);

children.name: text
children: provided it is safe to do so and without:

children.name: text
children: causing any health and safety risk;

children.name: text
children: damaging or compromising the Subcontract Works or the Project; or

children.name: text
children: affecting the Programme,
remove its plant, equipment, vehicles, and property (excluding any materials and goods intended for the Project) from Site;

children.name: text
children: allow the Contractor free use of its plant, materials, and property on Site and any materials or fabricated work lying at the Subcontractor’s workshops for the purposes of the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: hand over all Documents to the Contractor; and

children.name: text
children: comply with any other reasonable instruction from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontractor’s employment under the Subcontract is terminated any of the circumstances at Clauses 23.1.1 to 23.1.4:

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor shall comply with Clause 23.2; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall not be bound to make any further payment to the Subcontractor until the full and final cost of completion of the Subcontract Works and the making good of any defects,, whether by the Contractor or by others, has been ascertained.

Upon such costs being ascertained, the Contractor shall calculate the amount of any damage, loss and/or expense suffered or incurred by the Contractor. If the amount of any such damage, loss and/or expense incurred when added to the monies paid to the Subcontractor prior to the termination exceeds in total a fair and reasonable proportion of the Price commensurate with the proportion of the Subcontract Works properly carried out by the Subcontractor prior to the date of such termination, the difference shall be a debt recoverable by the Contractor from the Subcontractor, but otherwise shall be payable by the Contractor to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor’s employment under the Main Contract is terminated for any reason, the employment of the Subcontractor shall terminate automatically on the same date without notice to the Subcontractor, and in such case or in the case of termination under Clause 23.1.5:

children.name: text
children: the Subcontractor shall comply with Clause 23.2; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor’s sole liability to the Subcontractor shall be in respect of the Subcontract Works executed up to the date of termination and its reasonable and properly incurred costs of demobilisation.

The Subcontractor shall within 14 days of the termination submit a Subcontractor Payment Application for Subcontract Works properly executed by it up to the date of termination. Such Subcontractor Payment Application shall be treated in all respects as if it were the Subcontractor’s final account submitted pursuant to Clause 19.

children.name: text
children: {b:Indemnity}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out, complete and provide the Subcontract Works:

children.name: text
children: in accordance with the Main Contract; and

children.name: text
children: so as not to place the Contractor in breach of the Main Contract.

children.name: text
children: Further, to the extent applicable to the Subcontract Works the Subcontractor agrees to:

children.name: text
children: be bound to the Contractor by the terms of the Main Contract; and

children.name: text
children: assume toward the Contractor all the obligations, responsibilities and liabilities, including the responsibility for safety of the Subcontract Works, which the Contractor, pursuant to the Main Contract, assumes toward the Employer.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor confirms it has received a copy of the Main Contract and shall be deemed to know the provisions of the Main Contract insofar as they apply to the Subcontract Works (other than details of the Contractor's pricing).

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Contractor against all claims, demands, losses, costs, and expenses (including legal expenses and other professional fees) arising out of or in connection with:

children.name: text
children: any breach, non-observance or non-performance by the Subcontractor or his employees or agents of this Clause 24; and

children.name: text
children: any and all liabilities, claims, demands, causes of action, damages (and all damages in the broadest sense), costs, losses, penalties, fines, expenses (including, without limitation, court costs and reasonable legal expenses) due to or resulting from any negligence or breach of duty on the part of the Subcontractor, his employees or agents (including any misuse by him or them of any item of attendance or other property belonging to or provided by the Contractor).

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall at all times use best endeavours to avoid and shall indemnify and hold harmless the Contractor against all claims, demands, losses, costs, and expenses (including legal expenses and other professional fees) arising out of or in connection with:

children.name: text
children: any personal injury or death of any person;

children.name: text
children: loss of or damage to property; or

children.name: text
children: trespass, nuisance, or interference,

children.name: text
children: caused by the carrying out of the Subcontract Works, except if and to the extent caused by negligence of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:Insurances}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall maintain the following insurances at all times during the Project:

children.name: text
children: public liability insurance of at least the amount stated in the Subcontract Order for each and every claim (or such other basis as is stated in the Subcontract Order);

children.name: text
children: employer's liability insurance of at least the amount stated in the Subcontract Order for each and every claim (or such other basis as is stated in the Subcontract Order); and

children.name: text
children: where the Subcontractor is responsible for carrying out design, professional indemnity insurance of at least the amount stated in the Subcontract Order for each and every claim (or such other basis as is stated in the Subcontract Order) for a period of twelve years after practical completion of the Project.

children.name: text
children: Insurance policies pursuant to Clauses 25.1.1 and 25.1.2 shall be maintained by the Subcontractor until the expiry of the Rectification Period.

children.name: text
children: Professional indemnity insurance pursuant to Clause 25.1.3 shall be maintained by the Subcontractor provided always that such insurance continues to be available on commercially reasonable rates and terms, having regard (inter alia) to the premiums required by insurers and the policy terms obtainable by the Subcontractor, until 15 years after practical completion of the Subcontract Works. Any increased or additional premiums required by insurers because of the Subcontractor’s own claims record or other acts, omissions, matters or things peculiar to the Subcontractor shall be deemed to be within commercially reasonable rates and terms for the purposes of this Clause 25.3.

children.name: text
children: All insurance is to be with an insurer acceptable to the Contractor and not subject to any material excess or unusual exclusions.

children.name: text
children: As and when reasonably required so to do, the Subcontractor shall provide the Contractor with documentary evidence that the insurances required hereunder are in force and are being maintained.

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontractor fails to effect or maintain any required insurance the Contractor may insure on behalf of the Subcontractor and set-off the cost against any monies due to the Subcontractor or recover the cost as a debt

children.name: text
children: {b:Collateral Warranties}

children.name: text
children: As a precondition to payment, within 7 days of the date of this Subcontract the Subcontractor shall enter into and deliver to the Contractor a deed of collateral warranty in favour of the Employer in the form annexed to the Subcontract (or such other substantially similar form as the Contractor may reasonably require). Within 7 days’ notice from the Contractor and as a precondition to payment, the Subcontractor shall enter into and deliver to the Contractor a deed or deeds of collateral warranty with any funder, lessee or purchaser in the form or forms annexed to the Subcontract or in such other substantially similar form or forms as the Contractor may reasonably require.

children.name: text
children: Within 7 days’ of the engagement by the Subcontractor of any consultant and/or sub-sub-contractor employed by the Subcontractor  to carry out any design and/or construction of the Subcontract Works, and as a precondition to payment, the Subcontractor shall enter into and deliver to the Contractor a deed or deeds of sub-collateral warranty in favour of each of the Contractor and the Employer from any such consultant and/or sub-sub-contractor in the form or forms annexed to the Subcontract or in such other substantially similar form or forms as the Contractor may reasonably require.  Each sub-collateral warranty shall have attached a copy of relevant underlying sub-agreement (with any commercially sensitive financial information redacted if necessary).

children.name: text
children: {b:Assignment}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor may not assign, sub-contract or otherwise transfer the whole or any part of the benefit of, or any of the Subcontractor’s rights or obligations under, this Subcontract without the Contractor's prior written consent, which the Contractor may give or withhold in the Contractor’s absolute discretion.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may freely assign or charge the benefit of this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Third Party Rights}

children.name: text
children: Any person who is not a party to this Subcontract has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce any term or condition of this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Confidentiality}

children.name: text
children: Save as required by law, the Subcontractor shall not and shall procure that its employees, agents and representatives shall not without the prior written approval of the Contractor publish or disclose to any person (other than legal advisers) any of the Documents or other information relating to the Project and/or this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not without the prior written approval of the Contractor take or permit to be taken any photographs or video or other written or graphic media of the Project for use in any publicity or advertising.

children.name: text
children: {b:Data Protection}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall, at its own expense, ensure that it complies with and assists the Contractor to comply with the requirements of the Data Protection Laws in all respects relevant and applicable to the Project, the Subcontract Works and the performance of both parties' obligations under this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: Any breach of this Clause 30 by the Subcontractor shall entitle the Contractor to recover damages for any cost, expense, loss, or fine incurred by the Contractor which is attributable to the failure of the Subcontractor to meet its obligations under this Clause 30 on an indemnity basis.

children.name: text
children: {b:Anti-Bribery and Modern Slavery}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor hereby warrants, represents and undertakes to the Contractor that it shall:

children.name: text
children: comply with all applicable laws, statutes, regulations, and codes relating to anti-bribery and anti-corruption (“{b:Relevant Requirements}”), including, but not limited to, the UK Bribery Act 2010 (“{b:Bribery Act}”);

children.name: text
children: not engage in any activity, practice or conduct which would constitute an offence under the Bribery Act;

children.name: text
children: not do, or omit to do, any act that will cause or lead the Contractor to be in breach of any of the Relevant Requirements;

children.name: text
children: ensure that any person associated with it who is performing design and/or works in connection with this Subcontract (including any sub-sub-contractor or consultant) does so only on the basis of a written contract which imposes on and secures from such person terms equivalent to those imposed on the Subcontractor in this Clause 31 (“{b:Relevant Terms}”) and that it shall be responsible for the observance and performance by such person of the Relevant Terms, and shall be directly liable to the Contractor for any breach by such person of any of the Relevant Terms;

children.name: text
